title: Breakout
prompt:
Build Breakout on a 480x640 field: a paddle near the bottom, one ball and at least 5 rows of 8 bricks. The ball rests on the paddle until launched and bounces off the side and top walls, the paddle (the hit position sets the angle: right of centre deflects right) and bricks, which break and score at least 10. A ball below the bottom costs one of 3 lives and returns to the paddle; no lives left ends the game with won false, breaking every brick ends it with won true. The paddle stays inside the field. Keyboard: ArrowLeft/ArrowRight (A/D) move, Space launches. Touch/mouse: the paddle follows the finger's x; a tap launches.

Contract (window.Game; implement exactly):
- Game.start(): new game from any phase; phase becomes 'play'
- Game.getState(): {phase:'menu'|'play'|'over', score, lives, won, width:480, height:640, paddleX (centre), paddleW, ballX, ballY (centre), ballVX, ballVY (units per tick), ballAttached, bricks (count left), brickRects:[{x,y,w,h}]}
- Game.setSeed(n): seed the PRNG behind all randomness (applies at the next start())
- Game.step(n): advance exactly n fixed 1/60 s ticks synchronously
- Game.input.press(name): hold 'left' or 'right'
- Game.input.release(name): release it
- Game.input.action(): launch the resting ball upward at a seeded angle
- Game.debug.setBall(x, y, vx, vy): detach the ball and place it with that velocity per tick
- Game.debug.keepBricks(n): remove all bricks except the first n of brickRects, without scoring

Acceptance (checked by Kyora Bench browser tests): paddle moves and clamps; walls, paddle and bricks reflect the ball; misses cost lives; both endings; same seed and inputs give the same game; keyboard and touch work.
